note: Control IDs and titles follow ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A. The summaries and evidence hints are the project author's own paraphrases for retrieval and assessment; they are not the text of the standard. Consult the purchased standard for authoritative wording. The 'impact' weight (1-5) is a generic default used by the risk scorer - tune it for your organisation.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.summary: Management approves, publishes and communicates an information security policy plus topic-specific policies, and reviews them at planned intervals.
controls.evidence_hint: Approved policy set, version history, review records, communication or acknowledgement evidence

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.summary: Security responsibilities are defined and assigned to named roles across the organization.
controls.evidence_hint: RACI matrix, role descriptions, org chart, ISMS role appointments

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.summary: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility are separated to reduce the chance of unauthorized or accidental misuse.
controls.evidence_hint: Role matrices, access reviews showing separation, approval workflows

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.summary: Management requires all personnel to apply security in line with established policies and procedures.
controls.evidence_hint: Management review minutes, leadership directives, onboarding requirements

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.summary: Relevant authorities (regulators, law enforcement, emergency services) are identified and contact procedures are in place.
controls.evidence_hint: Authority contact list, escalation procedure, regulator notification procedure

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.summary: The organization keeps contact with security forums and professional associations to stay informed.
controls.evidence_hint: Memberships, subscriptions, advisory feed records

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.summary: Information about security threats is collected and analyzed to produce intelligence that informs decisions.
controls.evidence_hint: Threat feeds, advisories, threat analysis reports, risk assessment inputs

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.summary: Security requirements are built into project management for every kind of project.
controls.evidence_hint: Project methodology, security checkpoints, project risk assessments

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.summary: An inventory of information and associated assets is maintained and each asset has a named owner.
controls.evidence_hint: Asset register, owner assignments, inventory review records

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.summary: Rules for acceptable use and handling of information and assets are documented and implemented.
controls.evidence_hint: Acceptable use policy, signed acknowledgements, handling procedures

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.summary: Personnel and third parties return organizational assets when their employment, contract or agreement ends.
controls.evidence_hint: Offboarding checklist, asset return records

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.summary: Information is classified according to confidentiality, integrity, availability and legal needs.
controls.evidence_hint: Classification scheme, classified inventory, handling rules per class

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.summary: Procedures exist for labelling information consistently with the classification scheme.
controls.evidence_hint: Labelling procedure, sample labelled documents or templates

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.summary: Rules, procedures or agreements protect information transferred inside and outside the organization.
controls.evidence_hint: Transfer policy, NDAs, secure transfer tooling, data sharing agreements

controls.title: Access control
controls.summary: Rules to control physical and logical access are established based on business and security requirements.
controls.evidence_hint: Access control policy, need-to-know and least-privilege rules

controls.title: Identity management
controls.summary: The full life cycle of user identities is managed.
controls.evidence_hint: Joiner, mover, leaver procedure, identity registry, deprovisioning records

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.summary: Allocation and management of authentication secrets is controlled, and users are told how to handle them.
controls.evidence_hint: Password or credential policy, MFA enrolment, credential issuance procedure

controls.title: Access rights
controls.summary: Access rights are provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in line with policy.
controls.evidence_hint: Access request records, periodic access reviews, revocation evidence

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.summary: Processes manage the security risks tied to the use of suppliers' products and services.
controls.evidence_hint: Supplier security policy, supplier risk assessments, supplier register

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.summary: Relevant security requirements are established and agreed with each supplier in contracts.
controls.evidence_hint: Contract clauses, data processing agreements, security schedules

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.summary: Processes manage security risks in the supply chain of ICT products and services.
controls.evidence_hint: ICT supplier requirements, sub-processor lists, supply chain risk assessments

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.summary: Supplier security practices and service delivery are regularly monitored and reviewed, and changes are managed.
controls.evidence_hint: Supplier review reports, SLA reviews, review of supplier audit reports or certifications

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.summary: Processes govern the acquisition, use, management and exit of cloud services.
controls.evidence_hint: Cloud security policy, shared-responsibility mapping, cloud exit plans

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.summary: Incident management roles, responsibilities and processes are planned, defined and communicated.
controls.evidence_hint: Incident response policy or plan, roles, on-call rota, playbooks

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.summary: Security events are assessed to decide whether they should be classified as incidents.
controls.evidence_hint: Triage criteria, severity matrix, event assessment records

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.summary: Incidents are responded to following documented procedures.
controls.evidence_hint: Response procedures, incident tickets, incident logs

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.summary: Knowledge gained from incidents is used to strengthen controls.
controls.evidence_hint: Post-incident reviews, lessons learned, resulting corrective actions

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.summary: Procedures identify, collect, acquire and preserve evidence related to security events.
controls.evidence_hint: Evidence handling procedure, chain-of-custody forms

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.summary: Security is maintained at an appropriate level during a disruption.
controls.evidence_hint: Business continuity and DR plans with security requirements, disruption test records

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.summary: ICT readiness is planned, implemented, maintained and tested against business continuity objectives.
controls.evidence_hint: DR plan, RTO and RPO definitions, DR test results

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.summary: Applicable legal, regulatory and contractual security requirements are identified, documented and kept up to date.
controls.evidence_hint: Legal and obligations register, review records

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.summary: Procedures protect intellectual property rights, including software licensing.
controls.evidence_hint: Licence inventory, IP policy, software licensing controls

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.summary: Records are protected from loss, destruction, falsification and unauthorized access or release.
controls.evidence_hint: Records retention schedule, records protection procedure

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.summary: Privacy and PII protection requirements are identified and met.
controls.evidence_hint: Privacy policy, records of processing, DPIAs, data subject request procedure

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.summary: The approach to managing information security is independently reviewed at planned intervals.
controls.evidence_hint: Internal or external audit reports, independent assessment reports

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.summary: Compliance with the organization's security policies and standards is regularly reviewed.
controls.evidence_hint: Compliance check records, management reviews, audit findings tracking

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.summary: Operating procedures for information processing facilities are documented and available to those who need them.
controls.evidence_hint: Runbooks, SOPs, version-controlled procedure repository

controls.title: Screening
controls.summary: Background verification checks are done on candidates before joining and are proportionate to risk.
controls.evidence_hint: Screening policy, completed check records

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.summary: Employment agreements state the personnel's and the organization's security responsibilities.
controls.evidence_hint: Employment contract clauses, security acknowledgements

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.summary: Personnel receive appropriate security awareness, education and training, with regular updates.
controls.evidence_hint: Training programme, completion records, phishing exercises

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.summary: A formal disciplinary process addresses personnel who violate security policy.
controls.evidence_hint: Disciplinary policy, HR procedures

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.summary: Security duties that stay valid after leaving or changing roles are defined, communicated and enforced.
controls.evidence_hint: Exit procedure, post-employment obligations in contracts

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.summary: Confidentiality agreements reflecting the organization's needs are identified, signed and reviewed.
controls.evidence_hint: Signed NDAs, NDA template and review records

controls.title: Remote working
controls.summary: Security measures protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization's premises.
controls.evidence_hint: Remote working policy, VPN and endpoint requirements, remote access controls

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.summary: A mechanism lets personnel report observed or suspected security events promptly.
controls.evidence_hint: Reporting channel, awareness material, reported event log

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.summary: Security perimeters are defined and used to protect areas holding information and assets.
controls.evidence_hint: Site security design, perimeter descriptions, floor plans

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.summary: Secure areas are protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.
controls.evidence_hint: Access control system, visitor logs, badge issuance records

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.summary: Physical security is designed and applied to offices, rooms and facilities.
controls.evidence_hint: Facility security procedures, room access rules

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.summary: Premises are continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
controls.evidence_hint: CCTV or alarm records, monitoring procedure

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.summary: Protection is designed and implemented against natural disasters and other physical threats.
controls.evidence_hint: Environmental risk assessment, fire and flood controls, inspection records

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.summary: Security measures for working in secure areas are designed and applied.
controls.evidence_hint: Secure area rules, supervision procedures

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.summary: Clear desk rules for papers and media and clear screen rules for systems are defined and enforced.
controls.evidence_hint: Clear desk policy, screen lock settings, spot checks

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.summary: Equipment is sited and protected to reduce environmental and unauthorized access risks.
controls.evidence_hint: Equipment placement standards, server room controls

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.summary: Assets taken off-site are protected.
controls.evidence_hint: Off-site asset procedure, laptop encryption, travel guidance

controls.title: Storage media
controls.summary: Storage media are managed through their life cycle in line with classification and handling rules.
controls.evidence_hint: Media handling procedure, removable media controls, disposal logs

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.summary: Information processing facilities are protected from power failures and other utility disruptions.
controls.evidence_hint: UPS or generator tests, utility redundancy records

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.summary: Power and data cabling is protected from interception, interference and damage.
controls.evidence_hint: Cabling standards, inspection records

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.summary: Equipment is maintained correctly to preserve availability, integrity and confidentiality.
controls.evidence_hint: Maintenance schedule, service records

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.summary: Equipment containing storage media is checked so data is removed before disposal or re-use.
controls.evidence_hint: Disposal procedure, wipe or destruction certificates

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.summary: Information on user endpoint devices is protected.
controls.evidence_hint: Endpoint security standard, MDM enrolment, disk encryption evidence

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.summary: Allocation and use of privileged access rights is restricted and managed.
controls.evidence_hint: Privileged access policy, PAM tooling, admin account reviews

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.summary: Access to information and systems is restricted in line with the access control policy.
controls.evidence_hint: Application access matrices, permission configuration evidence

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.summary: Access to source code, development tools and libraries is appropriately managed.
controls.evidence_hint: Repository access controls, branch protection, code access reviews

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.summary: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented based on access restrictions.
controls.evidence_hint: MFA configuration, lockout and session settings, SSO configuration

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.summary: Resource use is monitored and adjusted against current and expected capacity needs.
controls.evidence_hint: Capacity monitoring reports, scaling or forecast records

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.summary: Malware protection is implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
controls.evidence_hint: Anti-malware or EDR deployment evidence, update policy, alerts

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.summary: Information about technical vulnerabilities is obtained, exposure is evaluated and appropriate action is taken.
controls.evidence_hint: Vulnerability scan reports, patch SLAs, remediation tracking

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.summary: Configurations of hardware, software, services and networks are established, documented and monitored.
controls.evidence_hint: Hardening baselines, configuration management tooling, drift reports

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.summary: Information in systems and devices is deleted when no longer required.
controls.evidence_hint: Retention and deletion procedure, deletion evidence

controls.title: Data masking
controls.summary: Data masking is used in line with access control and other policies and business requirements.
controls.evidence_hint: Masking standard, masked test data examples

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.summary: Data leakage prevention measures are applied to systems, networks and devices handling sensitive information.
controls.evidence_hint: DLP tooling and rules, egress controls, monitoring records

controls.title: Information backup
controls.summary: Backup copies of information, software and systems are kept and regularly tested.
controls.evidence_hint: Backup policy, backup job logs, restore test results

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.summary: Information processing facilities have enough redundancy to meet availability requirements.
controls.evidence_hint: Architecture diagrams, failover test records

controls.title: Logging
controls.summary: Logs recording activities, exceptions, faults and other events are produced, stored, protected and analyzed.
controls.evidence_hint: Logging standard, log retention settings, log protection controls

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.summary: Networks, systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate action is taken.
controls.evidence_hint: SIEM or alerting configuration, monitoring reports, alert handling records

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.summary: Clocks of information processing systems are synchronized to approved time sources.
controls.evidence_hint: NTP configuration standard, evidence of synchronization

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.summary: Use of utility programs that can override system and application controls is restricted and tightly controlled.
controls.evidence_hint: Utility restriction policy, approved tool list

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.summary: Procedures and measures securely manage software installation on operational systems.
controls.evidence_hint: Software installation procedure, approved software list, change records

controls.title: Networks security
controls.summary: Networks and network devices are secured, managed and controlled to protect information.
controls.evidence_hint: Network security standard, firewall rules, network diagrams

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.summary: Security mechanisms, service levels and requirements for network services are identified, implemented and monitored.
controls.evidence_hint: Network service agreements, SLA and security requirements

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.summary: Groups of information services, users and systems are segregated on the organization's networks.
controls.evidence_hint: Network segmentation design, VLAN or firewall zone evidence

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.summary: Access to external websites is managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.
controls.evidence_hint: Web filtering or proxy configuration, policy, block reports

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.summary: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including key management, are defined and implemented.
controls.evidence_hint: Cryptography policy, key management procedure, TLS and encryption standards

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.summary: Rules for the secure development of software and systems are established and applied.
controls.evidence_hint: SDLC policy, secure development procedure, security gates

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.summary: Security requirements are identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.
controls.evidence_hint: Security requirements templates, requirement reviews

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.summary: Principles for engineering secure systems are established, documented, maintained and applied.
controls.evidence_hint: Architecture standards, threat modelling records

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.summary: Secure coding principles are applied to software development.
controls.evidence_hint: Secure coding standards, code review records, static analysis results

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.summary: Security testing processes are defined and carried out across the development life cycle.
controls.evidence_hint: Test plans, penetration test reports, acceptance criteria

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.summary: Outsourced system development is directed, monitored and reviewed.
controls.evidence_hint: Outsourcing contracts, code delivery reviews, supplier security terms

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.summary: Development, testing and production environments are separated and secured.
controls.evidence_hint: Environment architecture, access separation evidence

controls.title: Change management
controls.summary: Changes to information processing facilities and systems follow change management procedures.
controls.evidence_hint: Change policy, change tickets, approvals and rollback plans

controls.title: Test information
controls.summary: Test information is appropriately selected, protected and managed.
controls.evidence_hint: Test data policy, anonymization procedure

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.summary: Audit tests and other assurance activities on operational systems are planned and agreed to limit disruption.
controls.evidence_hint: Audit and test planning, agreed scope and access approvals
